items.name: Melitan Ball
items.description: The finest craftsmanship on the islands. Catch multiplier 4.0x.

items.name: Greca Trap
items.description: A woven reed trap in an old Mediterranean pattern. Catch multiplier 1.5x.

items.name: Festa Trap
items.description: Decorated for the summer festa. Catch multiplier 2.0x.

items.name: Pastizz
items.description: A flaky savoury pastry sold at every ferry stop. Restores 15 HP when used.

items.name: Qassata
items.description: A ricotta-filled pastry parcel, hearty enough to restore 40 HP when used.

items.name: Ftira biz-Zejt
items.description: A whole olive-oil-soaked ftira loaf, packed with tomato and tuna — restores 80 HP when used.

items.name: Kinnie
items.description: A bittersweet local soft drink, said to make a creature grow a whole level in one gulp. Rare — never sold, only found as a wild-encounter drop.

items.name: Ħelwa tat-Tork
items.description: A dense slab of sesame halva. Brings a knocked-out creature back on its feet with half its HP, without a trip to the chapel.

items.name: Imqaret
items.description: Warm date-filled pastries from a festa stall. Sharing a few brings a creature much closer to you (+25 friendship).

items.name: Silent Bell
items.description: A bronze bell with no clapper-sound at all. Rung before the stone gate at Ġgantija Terrace, it parts the fog over the Ċittadella Ruins.

items.name: Il-Għajn Charm
items.description: The painted eye from the prow of a luzzu, on a cord. It keeps misfortune off: every trap you throw holds 25% better, and hidden glints show on the map from anywhere.

items.name: Luzzu Oar
items.description: A long oar painted blue, yellow and red. With it, the little boat at the jetty in Marsaxlokk Bay can row you out to Filfla Islet.

items.name: Signature Scroll
items.description: An old page of the temple builders' lore, naming the one move your starter's line was born for. Reading it taught them that move — keep it to remember.
